canonical.effect: Canonicalize D4-symmetric chance cache keys only after the existing leaf cutoff, including the diagnostic reference path.
canonical.cost: Transform/key arithmetic per nonleaf chance cache lookup; more cache reuse may offset that cost. Leaf heuristic and physics stay fixed.

serial_shallow.effect: Evaluate root passes serially only when requested pass depth<=2; deeper passes retain the existing parallel behavior.
serial_shallow.cost: May avoid thread launch/synchronization overhead at shallow depth; may lose useful shallow parallelism.

precision.effect: Keep native source identical to baseline, use threshold schedule[1e-5,1e-6] instead of[1e-4,1e-5,1e-6].
precision.cost: Stricter first-pass pruning may improve expectation accuracy while reducing completed depth under the same nominal budget.

banked_endgame.effect: Keep native source/heuristic/physics identical to baseline; accumulate nominal10ms per choose call and spend available credit with cap10ms before two CAP,40ms at exactly two CAP. This is a different resource regime, not the same per-call10ms hard cap.
banked_endgame.cost: Actual wall overshoot remains negative debt and is repaid by later allowances; even zero supplied budget may incur fallback/OS overhead. Report wall/CPU/depth and ledger deficit; no strict prefix-wall guarantee.

screen.order: rotate all five arms by seed; strictly serial

selection: most goals; ties baseline first, then lower measured choose-wall/completed-move, then declared arm order

control.order: alternate first label by seed, serial even when both labels use baseline
control.rationale: N=100 fixed before any search-alternatives game data; historical same-baseline wall-budget repeats differed by10 wins/60, so use a larger fresh paired control. This is not an extension after seeing p or outcomes.

criterion: nonbaseline finalist goals>baseline goals AND exact paired one-sided p<=0.05 AND zero limits; otherwise retain baseline. Actual choose-wall cost within +/-10% is reported separately, never assumed from the nominal budget.
stop: after all five predetermined arms/four rounds: update best goal count sequentially in sorted declared round order; local_plateau only if the final two rounds both fail to raise the previous best; otherwise bounded_neighborhood_exhausted. These are local bounded alternatives, never global optimum. No tuning on control.
scope: offline modeled Bonk only, fixed math/search alternatives without ML/training/fit; spawn-stage rules remain assumptions; four fixed profiles use nominal10ms per call, banked_endgame is a different resource regime with10ms allowance per call and a40ms late-call cap, not the same per-call hard cap; actual wall/CPU/latency and ledger debt are reported without censoring, no strict prefix-wall guarantee; unchanged native hard deadline for the supplied budget and budget+50ms unit gates still apply; no phone/default10s win-rate claim and no tuning on control

measurements.wall_samples: one monotonic elapsed sample for every choose call, including terminal None; exact sum equals search_wall_seconds
measurements.cpu: sum process_time elapsed around choose calls; includes native threads; search_cpu_seconds and per-completed-move ratio reported separately
measurements.latency: flatten all choose samples per arm, ordinary median, p95 nearest-rank ceil(.95*n), maximum, fraction strictly above nominal think
measurements.budget: budget_samples and pre-call decision_caps have one entry per choose call including None; final credit_balance=None for fixed, otherwise replay allowance+phase cap minus actual external wall, preserving negative debt; absolute validation tolerance1e-10
measurements.threshold_counts: completed moves only: positive info.threshold formatted.0e, fallback key when info.fallback or threshold=None; sum=moves, positive keys must belong to the source_arm schedule; no count for terminal None call
